note.summary: This chunk is an index page listing 29 GOV.UK documents in the HMRC rates and allowances collection, covering various UK taxes including Income Tax, Capital Gains Tax, Corporation Tax, National Insurance, VAT, and others. It provides titles, upstream last-updated dates, and links but no substantive rate figures itself. Several linked documents (Income Tax rates, CGT rates, NIC rates, HMRC interest rates) are directly relevant to Self Assessment calculations.
